description: Upgrade plan to migrate Java project to latest LTS versions

tasks.requirements: Upgrade JDK to version 21, update build configuration (pom.xml/build.gradle) to target Java 21, resolve any compilation issues, and update language features to leverage Java 21 capabilities
tasks.taskSummary: Successfully upgraded Java from version 17 to 21 (LTS). Updated pom.xml configuration, modernized code using OpenRewrite (Paths.get() to Path.of()), resolved all compilation issues. Build passed, all unit tests passed (1/1). Created modernization summary at 001-upgrade-java-to-21/modernization-summary.md.

tasks.requirements: Upgrade Spring Boot to 3.4, Spring Framework to 6.x, migrate javax.* packages to jakarta.*, update Spring configuration and deprecated APIs, and ensure compatibility with Java 21
tasks.taskSummary: Successfully upgraded Spring Boot from 3.2.1 to 3.4.2 (LTS) using milestone approach (3.2.1→3.3.13→3.4.2). Applied OpenRewrite recipes for code modernization (@Bean visibility, @RequestParam simplification). Fixed CVE-2025-49146 by upgrading PostgreSQL to 42.7.7. All builds passed, all tests passed (1/1), no CVE vulnerabilities. Created modernization summary at 002-upgrade-spring-boot-to-3.4/modernization-summary.md.
